segment_name_vi: Màn hình gaming IPS 27 inch QHD (2560x1440) 180-300Hz phổ thông
criteria: 27-inch, 2560x1440, IPS-type panel, 180-300Hz native refresh, mainstream gaming price band (~US$150-350)

specs.ports: 1x DP 1.4, 1x HDMI 2.0, 1x USB-C (DP Alt), headphone jack
specs.msrp_usd: ~$290 at TechSpot review (Jul 2024); not an official MSRP

competitors.kvm: No (TechSpot: no USB hub or KVM)

specs.ports: 1x DP 1.4a (180Hz), 2x HDMI 2.0b (144Hz), 1x USB-C (DP Alt, 180Hz), USB-B up, 2x USB-A 2.0, headphone out
specs.msrp_usd: ~$250 street per PCMonitors (Feb 2025); official MSRP not found

specs.ports: HDMI 2.0, DP 1.2a, headphone jack (counts not given)

competitors.spec_source_note: Samsung.com page not reachable; specs from PCMonitors news/spec overview

specs.ports: 1x DP 1.4, 2x HDMI 2.0, headphone jack; external PSU

competitors.spec_source_note: LG.com page not reached; specs via PCMonitors. Alternative 240Hz LG: 27GR83Q-B (RTINGS reviewed; data gated)

specs.ports: 2x HDMI 2.0, 1x DP 1.4, headphone jack; internal PSU

benchmarks.verdict: Tom's calls it a no-frills value 240Hz gamer with unusually high IPS contrast (>1,300:1); tilt-only stand, no USB.

metrics.total input lag (ms): 19 (lowest of its comparison group; Lenovo G27q-30 25ms)

benchmarks.verdict: Value 180Hz QHD that 'acts like a premium gaming monitor': fastest input lag in its test group, ~30% above-average contrast, KVM and height-adjust stand.
Exceptional out-of-box accuracy (top percentile) but ordinary ~1,000:1 contrast; slower lag than M27QA ICE in Tom's tests.

metrics.avg GtG response @180Hz OD10 (ms): 4.5 (cumulative deviation ~400); 3.5 at OD15 with inverse ghosting

benchmarks.verdict: Best motion tuning at its price per Monitors Unboxed; ~30% better cumulative deviation than Gigabyte M27Q P and ~20% better than MSI G274QPF-QD; weak contrast, no real HDR, no USB hub/KVM.
PCMonitors rates it superior to the Dell G2725D: wider QD gamut with emulation modes, brighter, better tuned responses at max Hz, strobe, KVM, full stand.

benchmarks.source: PCMonitors (forum review vs MSI 274QRF QD E2)
benchmarks.verdict: Good budget IPS responses and very low input lag, slightly stronger static contrast than the MSI, but no colour-space emulation, no HDR, tilt-only; wins on price (~$150-200).
Named best budget high-refresh LCD for slightly better response tuning, colour accuracy and calibration options; TechSpot XG27ACS review notes similar avg response but higher overshoot than XG27ACS.

notes: RTINGS review pages (M27Q rev2, 27GR83Q-B, G2725D, etc.) exist but RTINGS content was gated/blocked from this environment (proxy refused rtings.com; WebFetch returned only metadata), so NO RTINGS numbers were recorded. No third-party lab review found for M27Q3/G27Q3 (PCMonitors spec page says 300Hz native + factory OC to 320Hz, 2x HDMI 2.1, DP1.4, USB-C 18W, KVM, 2x5W speakers, ~GBP330), M27Q2 QD, or G27Q20/G27Q2. Samsung G50D and LG 27GS75Q have no measured reviews in the sources searched (PCMonitors only has spec overviews). Samsung/LG/Dell specs came from PCMonitors spec pages because official sites were not fetched. MSRPs are street/listed prices at the time of the cited article, not verified launch MSRPs. Tom's Hardware input-lag (total, ms) and TechSpot processing lag (ms) use different methodologies and are not directly comparable.
